en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street scene labeled "Rosswein. Kreuzplatz." On the left is a multi‑storey building with shuttered windows and a sign reading "Richard Schlicke." In the background to the right stands a small chapel or church behind a low wall and ornate gate, with leafless trees around it. Several people, including children, walk or stand in the street leading toward the chapel.
